title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
label: AAA
evidence_summary: GameSpot: Sony documents filed in the FTC v. Microsoft case show The Last of Us Part II cost $220 million to develop. The evidence is for the original 2020 game; this Steam app is its remaster.

title: Horizon Forbidden West Complete Edition
label: AAA
evidence_summary: GameSpot: Sony documents filed in the FTC v. Microsoft case show Horizon Forbidden West cost $212 million to develop, with a peak of over 300 full-time staff. The evidence is for the base game in this edition.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
label: AAA
evidence_summary: Guinness World Records lists the largest development team for a video game: about 2,000 Rockstar employees, 1,600 of them working directly on the game (per producer Rob Nelson).

title: Baldur's Gate 3
label: AAA
